name: Audit Ethical Persuasion
summary: Audit persuasive design for informed choice, evidence, accessibility, and avoidable manipulation.
description: Audit marketing copy and interaction design for persuasive mechanisms, user comprehension, claim support, autonomy, accessibility, and dark-pattern risk. Use before shipping a conversion experience or when trust and pressure tactics need independent review.
refuses: It does not optimize coercion, shame, addiction, confusion, false scarcity, or obstructed cancellation.
It does not treat a disclosed dark pattern as ethical merely because text exists somewhere.
It does not provide legal approval or claim that conversion lift justifies user harm.
